analyzed_vuln.description: `CFF2VariationStore::serialize` trusts the in-font `size` field via `varStore->get_size()` and blindly `memcpy`s that many bytes from `varStore` into the output buffer. There is no bounds check that the source range `[varStore, varStore + size)` is within the original CFF2 table blob. In this PoV, `size` is larger than the actual remaining bytes, so memcpy performs an out-of-bounds read from the fuzzer input buffer (heap-buffer-overflow). The crash happens during serialization, but the root cause is missing source-size validation in this serializer path.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a CFF2 font with a non-null Variation Store (`vstoreOffset` present) and a malformed Variation Store `size` field that overstates available data. The subset pipeline (`hb_subset` -> `hb_subset_cff2` -> `_write_cff2`) reaches `CFF2VariationStore::serialize`, which copies `size` bytes from the mapped source table. If the declared size extends past the actual input blob, ASan reports OOB read during `memcpy`.
